title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E12 — A Visit From Lena Horne
Fred spots Lena Horne's car in the parking lot while touring the NBC Studios and sneaks away to meet 'the first lady of his dreams.' When there is no answer to the knock on Lena's dressing room door, Fred enters and inspects her personal belongings.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E13 — Sanford & Son & Sister Makes Three
Fred's old flame Juanita brings her daughter Alice to dinner and it's love at first sight for Lamont. Juanita discloses a very delicate and difficult situation when she tells Fred that Alice is really his daughter -- and Lamont is thus dating his sister.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E14 — Fred & Carol & Fred & Donna
When Fred invites his fiancée Donna and a door-to-door saleslady to dinner on the same evening, Lamont is convulsed by his father's attempts to keep the women apart.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E15 — A Guest In The Yard
Fred and Lamont find a bum in their yard. The Sanfords are jumping to his every whim for fear he'll make good his threat. The uninvited guest claims Fred pushed him -- creating untold injuries -- and he's threatened to sue them for everything they own.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E13 — Louise's Sister
A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E14 — Louise's Reunion
When Louise finds out about a new clause in George's will, she almost gives him cause to use it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E15 — A Bedtime Story
George's problems in the bedroom send him on a panicked search for solutions, from some of the most unlikely sources.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E16 — Florence Meets Mr. Right
When George and Louise meet Florence's intended, they worry that he may be too good to be true -- and soon find out they are exactly right.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E17 — Louise's Award
Louise's donation to charity might win her a special award, if George's 'donation' to a politician doesn't ruin her chances.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E12 — Tony Randall, Burns & Schreiber
Window washer (Flip) advises corporate execs; Burns & Schreiber do their taxi routine and Tony's a Chinese football doctor.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E13 — Bill Russell, Johnny Cash, June Carter
Flip plays Bill Russell in a game of 1-on-1 (chess, that is) and Geraldine square dances with Johnny Cash.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E14 — Slappy White, Tim Conway
Slappy does stand-up; sketches include Pink Pirate (Conway) w/castaways (Flip & Slappy) and a convoluted con game.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E15 — James Coco, Barbara McNair, Jim Nabors
Coco, Nabors & Flip do theater parody; Freddie Johnson shops for a card and Geraldine battles McNair to be queen of a parade.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E4 — James Baldwin - Part 1
Author James Baldwin is interviewed by the young Black poetess Nikki Giovanni in a special two-part presentation of Soul!, taped in London.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E5 — James Baldwin - Part 2
The second installment in a special, two-part program featuring James Baldwin.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E1 — The Landlords
George and Katherine, who bought Bill & Cassie's house, have a three-ring circus with the clown they found to rent the downstairs apartment.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E2 — The Derby
George is so obsessed with Webster winning a derby that he builds the car without him, hurting his feelings since Webster wanted to build the car together.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E3 — A Run for the Money
George secures a $10,000 pledge for Katherine to run in a 10K charity race, but when she's injured, Webster decides to run for her.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E4 — Read It and Weep
The family thinks Papa has a vision problem, but the truth is that Papa never learned to read.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E5 — Witchbusters
Webster meets a lonely woman on a dare from his friends and finds out that she is not the witch they said she was.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E13 — Two Guys, A Girl, and a Calendar
Tia and Tamera battle it out on behalf of their guys as competition gets tight for a spot in their school's 12 Most Gorgeous Men on Campus calendar.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E14 — Sweet Talk
Tamera lands a job as a radio talk show hostess dispensing advice on love on romance, including her own sister Tia's -- but without Tia's permission!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E15 — Father's Day
The twins think a photojournalist visiting campus may be their biological father.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E16 — I Know What You Did In Drama Class
Diavian and Tyreke become partners in drama class but Tia flips out after catching them in a passionate kiss during a drama rehearsal. Tamera and Jordan try to hook up cable in the girl's room.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E17 — Double Talk
Jordan's guest shot on Tamera's radio show turns into a full-time gig, but it may cost them their friendship.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E14 — Guess Q’s Coming To Dinner
Mo is shirking her duties at home and her grades are falling.  Frank blames Q.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E20 — The Ones You Love
The first casualty from George and Louise's vicious verbal battle could be the interviewer interested in their 'perfect marriage.
